correctness.rationale: Perron-Frobenius on signless Laplacian makes top Laplacian eigenvalue simple and its eigenvector opposite-signed by bipartition. At h<=2/lambda, coordinate displacement <=h d_i<=2, so no 2-step torus lattice winding (total <=4<2pi); a nonzero real 2-cycle contradicts (2/h)||d||^2 < d^T L d <= lambda||d||^2 via the strict cosine integral. At h*=2/lambda, Lyapunov-Schmidt on the top eigenspace gives cubic coefficient S4/(3lambda), unique positive amplitude branch for h>h*, J_h(u)^2 contracts transversely, and the odd center manifold yields t a_t^2->3lambda/(2S4) outside the strong-stable manifold. Independent two-node benchmark verified lambda=2,S4=4, nearcritical branches, and 100000-step critical ratio 0.999635589. Finite checks do not certify all weighted graphs.
